0022600182.text: The Raptors (3-3) are 7th in the East and on a two-game losing streak, with a 1-2 road record, while the Nuggets (3-2) are 8th in the West and riding a two-game winning streak. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard, Jakob Poeltl and Nate Bittle, and Denver is without Julian Strawther and Spencer Jones. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Toronto lost both games of their 2025-26 season series, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20.
